prompt: Write me the script for a scene. The context: Sarah Rose, (Rosie is her nickname) is the youngest of the five Roy siblings, the youngest by far. She was the product of an affair Logan had with his secretary at the time. When her mother killed herself Sarah was only 10 months old and sent to Logan Roy’s care, or rather, the care of multiple nannies, and sometimes her older siblings. Thus she’s not as messed up by Logan as the other siblings are, but conversely due to it she often feels adrift, easily isolated from her family. The figures she probably most associates as mother/father figures are Kendall and Rava, she lived with them for a few years when she was a preteen and their daughter was a baby. She’s 24 when Kendall throws his chaotic 40th birthday bash. After his move against Logan in the press his other younger siblings are basically at war with him, but most of the corporate stuff means nothing to Sarah, she understands it, but she doesn’t care about it. The scene: Sarah Rose arrives at Kendall’s birthday party, she isn’t super comfortable in the loud environment, surrounded by so many people and flashing lights. She used to be a bit of a party girl, but not lately. Despite her discomfort she’s hopeful to spend a bit of time with some of her siblings, even if they won’t all actually hang out together. Use at least 183 unique words in the response.
